ucs.title: [LLM] Gamaredon (Shuckworm) Office-spawned VBS/HTA loader chain (PteroPSLoad / GammaLoad)
ucs.description: Hunts the signature Gamaredon initial-access chain: a maldoc opened in Word/Excel/PowerPoint (often delivered via SBU/UA government lures) spawns wscript/cscript/mshta to execute a VBS or HTA stager from %TEMP%, %APPDATA%\Microsoft\Office\ or %PUBLIC% that then downloads next-stage Pterodo/GammaSteel. Office→script-host parentage combined with these specific write paths is overwhelmingly characteristic of Gamaredon vs other RU APTs that prefer ISO/LNK or HTML smuggling.
ucs.splunk: | tstats summariesonly=false count min(_time) as firstTime max(_time) as lastTime FROM datamodel=Endpoint.Processes WHERE Processes.parent_process_name IN ("winword.exe","excel.exe","powerpnt.exe","outlook.exe") AND Processes.process_name IN ("wscript.exe","cscript.exe","mshta.exe","powershell.exe","cmd.exe") BY host Processes.user Processes.parent_process_name Processes.process_name Processes.process Processes.process_id Processes.parent_process_id | `drop_dm_object_name(Processes)` | where match(process, "(?i)(\\AppData\\|\\Temp\\|\\Public\\|\\Users\\Public\\|\\ProgramData\\)") OR match(process, "(?i)\.(vbs|vbe|hta|js|jse|wsf)(\"|\s|$)") OR match(process, "(?i)(http[s]?://|mshta\.exe\s+http|wscript\.exe.*\.(vbs|vbe))") | `security_content_ctime(firstTime)` | `security_content_ctime(lastTime)`
ucs.kql:
let officeParents = dynamic(["winword.exe","excel.exe","powerpnt.exe","outlook.exe","olk.exe"]);
let scriptChildren = dynamic(["wscript.exe","cscript.exe","mshta.exe","powershell.exe","pwsh.exe","cmd.exe"]);
DeviceProcessEvents
| where Timestamp > ago(7d)
| where InitiatingProcessFileName in~ (officeParents)
| where FileName in~ (scriptChildren)
| where AccountName !endswith "$"
| where ProcessCommandLine matches regex @"(?i)\\(AppData|Temp|Public|ProgramData|Users\\Public)\\"
   or ProcessCommandLine matches regex @"(?i)\.(vbs|vbe|hta|js|jse|wsf)(\"|\s|$)"
   or ProcessCommandLine matches regex @"(?i)\s+https?://"
   or ProcessCommandLine matches regex @"(?i)(GetObject|CreateObject|MSXML2\.XMLHTTP|WScript\.Shell|ADODB\.Stream)"
| project Timestamp, DeviceName, AccountName,
          ParentImage = InitiatingProcessFolderPath,
          ParentCmd   = InitiatingProcessCommandLine,
          ChildImage  = FolderPath,
          ChildCmd    = ProcessCommandLine,
          SHA256, InitiatingProcessSHA256
| order by Timestamp desc
ucs.sentinel_kql:
let officeParents = dynamic(["winword.exe","excel.exe","powerpnt.exe","outlook.exe","olk.exe"]);
let scriptChildren = dynamic(["wscript.exe","cscript.exe","mshta.exe","powershell.exe","pwsh.exe","cmd.exe"]);
SecurityEvent
| where TimeGenerated > ago(7d)
| where EventID == 4688
| extend ParentName = tolower(tostring(split(ParentProcessName, "\\")[-1]))
| extend ChildName  = tolower(tostring(split(NewProcessName,    "\\")[-1]))
| where ParentName in (officeParents)
| where ChildName in (scriptChildren)
| where SubjectUserName !endswith "$"
| where CommandLine matches regex @"(?i)\\(AppData|Temp|Public|ProgramData|Users\\Public)\\"
   or CommandLine matches regex @"(?i)\.(vbs|vbe|hta|js|jse|wsf)(\"|\s|$)"
   or CommandLine matches regex @"(?i)\s+https?://"
   or CommandLine matches regex @"(?i)(GetObject|CreateObject|MSXML2\.XMLHTTP|WScript\.Shell|ADODB\.Stream)"
| project TimeGenerated, Computer, SubjectUserName, ParentProcessName, NewProcessName, CommandLine
ucs.sigma_yaml:
title: Gamaredon Office-spawned VBS/HTA Loader Chain
id: 9b4d3a2f-1c5e-4d2a-8f7b-3e6a9c1d2b34
status: experimental
description: Detects Gamaredon's signature initial-access chain where Office spawns a script host running a VBS/HTA stager from user-writable paths.
author: SOC Detection Engineering
date: 2026-05-23
references:
  - https://attack.mitre.org/groups/G0047/
  - https://www.welivesecurity.com/en/eset-research/gamaredon-pterodo-back-and-targeting-ukrainian-government/
logsource:
  category: process_creation
  product: windows
detection:
  selection_parent:
    ParentImage|endswith:
      - '\winword.exe'
      - '\excel.exe'
      - '\powerpnt.exe'
      - '\outlook.exe'
      - '\olk.exe'
  selection_child:
    Image|endswith:
      - '\wscript.exe'
      - '\cscript.exe'
      - '\mshta.exe'
      - '\powershell.exe'
      - '\pwsh.exe'
      - '\cmd.exe'
  selection_payload:
    CommandLine|re|i:
      - '\\(AppData|Temp|Public|ProgramData|Users\\Public)\\'
      - '\.(vbs|vbe|hta|js|jse|wsf)("|\s|$)'
      - '\shttps?://'
      - '(GetObject|CreateObject|MSXML2\.XMLHTTP|WScript\.Shell|ADODB\.Stream)'
  condition: selection_parent and selection_child and selection_payload
fields:
  - User
  - ParentImage
  - Image
  - CommandLine
falsepositives:
  - Legitimate Office add-ins that invoke scripting hosts (rare; baseline per environment)
  - Macro-based corporate tooling (allowlist by signed-add-in SHA256)
level: high
tags:
  - attack.initial_access
  - attack.t1566.001
  - attack.execution
  - attack.t1059.005
  - attack.t1218.005
  - attack.g0047
ucs.datadog_query: source:windows.sysmon @EventID:1 @ParentImage:(*\\winword.exe OR *\\WINWORD.EXE OR *\\excel.exe OR *\\EXCEL.EXE OR *\\powerpnt.exe OR *\\POWERPNT.EXE OR *\\outlook.exe OR *\\OUTLOOK.EXE) @Image:(*\\wscript.exe OR *\\WScript.exe OR *\\WSCRIPT.EXE OR *\\cscript.exe OR *\\CScript.exe OR *\\CSCRIPT.EXE OR *\\mshta.exe OR *\\MSHTA.exe OR *\\MSHTA.EXE OR *\\powershell.exe OR *\\PowerShell.exe OR *\\POWERSHELL.EXE OR *\\cmd.exe OR *\\CMD.EXE) @CommandLine:(*AppData* OR *appdata* OR *Temp* OR *TEMP* OR *Public* OR *PUBLIC* OR *ProgramData* OR *.vbs* OR *.VBS* OR *.vbe* OR *.hta* OR *.HTA* OR *http\:* OR *https\:* OR *MSXML2* OR *WScript.Shell* OR *ADODB.Stream*)
ucs.falcon_logscale_query:
#event_simpleName=ProcessRollup2 ParentBaseFileName=/(winword|excel|powerpnt|outlook|olk)\.exe$/i ImageFileName=/(wscript|cscript|mshta|powershell|pwsh|cmd)\.exe$/i
| regex("(?i)(\\\\(AppData|Temp|Public|ProgramData|Users\\\\Public)\\\\|\\.(vbs|vbe|hta|js|jse|wsf)|https?://|GetObject|CreateObject|MSXML2\\.XMLHTTP|WScript\\.Shell|ADODB\\.Stream)", field=CommandLine)
| groupBy([aid, ComputerName, UserName, ParentBaseFileName, ImageFileName, CommandLine], function=[count(), min(@timestamp), max(@timestamp)])
| _count > 0

ucs.title: [LLM] Gamaredon Telegram/Telegraph dead-drop resolver from script-host (Pterodo C2 IP fetch)
ucs.description: Hunts Gamaredon's distinctive C2 bootstrap: PteroPSLoad/GammaSteel/Pterodo variants resolve their next-stage C2 IP by fetching a Telegram channel, t.me short link, telegra.ph article, or telegram.dog/graph.org mirror — encoding the IP in the page body. Catches the moment a Windows scripting host (wscript/cscript/mshta/powershell) — not a browser — talks to a Telegram-family domain, which is a near-pathognomonic Gamaredon signal documented by ESET, Symantec, and Unit 42.
ucs.splunk: | tstats summariesonly=false count min(_time) as firstTime max(_time) as lastTime FROM datamodel=Network_Traffic.All_Traffic WHERE All_Traffic.app IN ("wscript.exe","cscript.exe","mshta.exe","powershell.exe","pwsh.exe","hta.exe","rundll32.exe") AND (All_Traffic.dest="*telegra.ph*" OR All_Traffic.dest="*t.me*" OR All_Traffic.dest="*api.telegram.org*" OR All_Traffic.dest="*telegram.dog*" OR All_Traffic.dest="*graph.org*" OR All_Traffic.dest="*telegram.org*") BY host All_Traffic.src All_Traffic.user All_Traffic.app All_Traffic.dest All_Traffic.dest_port | `drop_dm_object_name(All_Traffic)` | `security_content_ctime(firstTime)` | `security_content_ctime(lastTime)`
ucs.kql:
let scripting = dynamic(["wscript.exe","cscript.exe","mshta.exe","powershell.exe","pwsh.exe","rundll32.exe","hta.exe"]);
let deaddrops = dynamic(["telegra.ph","t.me","api.telegram.org","telegram.org","telegram.dog","graph.org"]);
let ddns = dynamic([".ddns.net",".hopto.org",".no-ip.org",".myftp.biz",".sytes.net",".serveftp.com",".freedynamicdns.net",".redirectme.net",".ru",".info"]);
let ResolverHits =
  DeviceNetworkEvents
  | where Timestamp > ago(7d)
  | where InitiatingProcessFileName in~ (scripting)
  | where RemoteUrl has_any (deaddrops)
     or RemoteUrl matches regex @"(?i)(telegra\.ph|t\.me/|api\.telegram\.org|telegram\.dog|graph\.org)"
  | project ResolverTime = Timestamp, DeviceName, DeviceId,
            InitiatingProcessAccountName, InitiatingProcessFileName,
            InitiatingProcessCommandLine, InitiatingProcessId,
            ResolverUrl = RemoteUrl, ResolverIP = RemoteIP;
ResolverHits
| join kind=leftouter (
    DeviceNetworkEvents
    | where Timestamp > ago(7d)
    | where InitiatingProcessFileName in~ (scripting)
    | where RemoteUrl matches regex @"(?i)(\.ddns\.net|\.hopto\.org|\.no-ip\.org|\.myftp\.biz|\.sytes\.net|\.serveftp\.com|\.freedynamicdns\.net|\.redirectme\.net|\.(ru|info)$)"
       or (RemoteIPType == "Public" and isempty(RemoteUrl))
    | project FollowOnTime = Timestamp, DeviceId, FollowOnUrl = RemoteUrl, FollowOnIP = RemoteIP, FollowOnPort = RemotePort, FollowOnPid = InitiatingProcessId
  ) on DeviceId
| where FollowOnTime between (ResolverTime .. ResolverTime + 10m)
| where InitiatingProcessAccountName !endswith "$"
| project ResolverTime, FollowOnTime,
          DelaySec = datetime_diff('second', FollowOnTime, ResolverTime),
          DeviceName, InitiatingProcessAccountName,
          InitiatingProcessFileName, InitiatingProcessCommandLine,
          ResolverUrl, ResolverIP, FollowOnUrl, FollowOnIP, FollowOnPort
| order by ResolverTime desc
ucs.sentinel_kql:
let scripting = dynamic(["wscript.exe","cscript.exe","mshta.exe","powershell.exe","pwsh.exe","rundll32.exe","hta.exe"]);
let deaddropRx = @"(?i)(telegra\.ph|t\.me|api\.telegram\.org|telegram\.org|telegram\.dog|graph\.org)";
let ddnsRx     = @"(?i)(\.ddns\.net|\.hopto\.org|\.no-ip\.org|\.myftp\.biz|\.sytes\.net|\.serveftp\.com|\.freedynamicdns\.net|\.redirectme\.net|\.(ru|info)$)";
let Resolver =
  ImWebSession
  | where TimeGenerated > ago(7d)
  | where tolower(tostring(split(SrcUsername, "\\")[-1])) !endswith "$"
  | extend procName = tolower(tostring(split(coalesce(HttpRequestHeaderUserAgent, FileName, ""), "\\")[-1]))
  | where Url matches regex deaddropRx
  | project ResolverTime = TimeGenerated, SrcHostname, SrcIpAddr, SrcUsername, ResolverUrl = Url, ResolverDst = DstIpAddr;
Resolver
| join kind=leftouter (
    ImNetworkSession
    | where TimeGenerated > ago(7d)
    | where Url matches regex ddnsRx or DstHostname matches regex ddnsRx
    | project FollowOnTime = TimeGenerated, SrcHostname, FollowOnDst = DstIpAddr, FollowOnHost = DstHostname, FollowOnPort = DstPortNumber
  ) on SrcHostname
| where FollowOnTime between (ResolverTime .. ResolverTime + 10m)
| project ResolverTime, FollowOnTime,
          DelaySec = datetime_diff('second', FollowOnTime, ResolverTime),
          SrcHostname, SrcUsername, SrcIpAddr,
          ResolverUrl, ResolverDst, FollowOnHost, FollowOnDst, FollowOnPort
| order by ResolverTime desc

title: Gamaredon Telegram/Telegraph Dead-Drop Resolver from Script Host
id: 7e2a8c91-4f6d-43b8-9a1c-2d8e5b7f4a01
status: experimental
description: Detects a Windows scripting host (wscript/cscript/mshta/powershell/rundll32) issuing an HTTP(S) request to Telegram-family domains used by Gamaredon as a dead-drop resolver for next-stage C2 IPs.
author: SOC Detection Engineering
date: 2026-05-23
references:
  - https://attack.mitre.org/groups/G0047/
  - https://symantec-enterprise-blogs.security.com/threat-intelligence/shuckworm-gamaredon-russia-ukraine
  - https://unit42.paloaltonetworks.com/trident-ursa/
logsource:
  category: network_connection
  product: windows
detection:
  selection_proc:
    Image|endswith:
      - '\wscript.exe'
      - '\cscript.exe'
      - '\mshta.exe'
      - '\powershell.exe'
      - '\pwsh.exe'
      - '\rundll32.exe'
  selection_host:
    DestinationHostname|contains:
      - 'telegra.ph'
      - 't.me'
      - 'api.telegram.org'
      - 'telegram.org'
      - 'telegram.dog'
      - 'graph.org'
  condition: selection_proc and selection_host
fields:
  - Image
  - User
  - DestinationHostname
  - DestinationIp
  - DestinationPort
falsepositives:
  - PowerShell-based monitoring tools that fetch Telegram bot APIs (allowlist by signed binary SHA256 + bot token)
level: high
tags:
  - attack.command_and_control
  - attack.t1102.001
  - attack.t1071.001
  - attack.g0047
ucs.datadog_query: source:windows.sysmon @EventID:3 @Image:(*\\wscript.exe OR *\\WScript.exe OR *\\WSCRIPT.EXE OR *\\cscript.exe OR *\\CSCRIPT.EXE OR *\\mshta.exe OR *\\MSHTA.EXE OR *\\powershell.exe OR *\\PowerShell.exe OR *\\POWERSHELL.EXE OR *\\pwsh.exe OR *\\rundll32.exe OR *\\RUNDLL32.EXE) @DestinationHostname:(*telegra.ph* OR *Telegra.ph* OR *t.me* OR *T.ME* OR *api.telegram.org* OR *telegram.org* OR *Telegram.org* OR *telegram.dog* OR *graph.org* OR *Graph.org*)
